item.tib: mchog sprul Rin po che kun gsal nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar gsal byed rin chen dngul gyi me long
item.coloph: zhes skyang spral rin po che kun gsal nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi bka' 'bum rin chen gter gyi bang mdzod dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu zhes bya ba dang / bla ma'i rnam thar gsal byed rin chen dngul gyi me long dang bcas pa rnam gnon zhes pa lcags pho 'brug gi lo ston zla ra ba 'bras bu thams cad smin pa'i dus su/ gdan sa dag pa'i gling mchog mda' chen dkar mo ri khrod du/ phran nyag sgom rad Na khod spyod kyis/ dad pa gsum gyi gzhi bting / dge ba bcu yi lam bsgrod/ bla na med pa'i 'bras bu la longs spyod cing / dga' bde mos pa'i blo dang bcas nas / dam pa rin po che'i zhabs drung du 'khod cing bkod pa dge legs bkra shis phyogs bcur dar rgyas shog de dag las byung dge rtsa bslu med gser/ bskal pa rgya mtshor mi 'dzad gter du bzhugs/ bdag sogs skye dgu'i bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ bskyed pa'i rgyu ru yun du gnas gyur cig dge'o//
